text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You let me take such good care of you last year. I hope you'll let me do the same again this year.
choice_data_list: I still feel like it's supposed to be the other way around…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hmm, really? Anyway, it's a day to celebrate, so let's not dwell on it.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Sorry to change the subject, but could I tell you my resolution for this year?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: This year, I want to spoil you like you've never been spoiled before! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I know I shouldn't jump the gun or anything, but I just can't wait any longer…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: So, um… could I start this new year by coddling you?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Your wish is my command, so let me know what you want!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I feel like this is less of a resolution and more of a New Year's gift…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What should I request?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, a home-cooked meal? You've got it!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: New Year's only rolls around once every twelve months, so I was thinking I'd cook something special for you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Let's get right to it!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: All done! Seven-herb ozoni, softened black beans, and a Happy New Year hamburger steak! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I hope you don't mind if I feed you the first bite…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Okay, open wide! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Each dish is flavorful and rich in nutrients! Super Creek seems to be enjoying the food too.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Really? You're not going to wish for anything?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Grrr, then we'll just have to see who breaks first. I'm not going home until you wish for something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Several hours later…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yaaawn… It's about time you told me your wish…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You've been waiting for so long. Surely there's something you want to wish for.
choice_data_list: I want to lay my head on your lap and take a nap…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Finally, a wish! Go right ahead!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm also feeling… rather… Zzz…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We fall asleep on top of each other. The pleasant warmth sends us both into a deep slumber.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe, you've got it! Getting praised right from day one should help your personal growth all year long!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Okay, here I go. You're such a good trainer! The very best there is! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Huh, what was that light just now? It looked like my hand was glowing for a second there…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Did something happen? Is this what they call a supernatural phenomenon?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My mind is suddenly flooded with ideas. I feel like I can teach Super Creek anything!
